snippet.title: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown - a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is available to play now in Early Access on Steam, with a full release coming on June 18th. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Thriveheavyliesthecrown
